best.explanation: Rey Cortiço looks like a clean small north coast window for Rare window, Medium confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 26 kJ, 9 s period, lully 4/100, and good wind at 5 km/h.  An open beach break where the sandbanks decide everything; this is best for quiet, punchy peaks when Lagide is too small; 6-9s at mid tide can turn Belgas punchy and rippable, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully.
